titles.title: No Cash for Incompetent and Malicious Contractors Act
No Cash for Incompetent and Malicious Contractors Act
A bill to require the debarment of any Federal contractor who improperly discloses personally identifiable information, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs under authority of the order of the Senate of 09/30/2026.
